name: robots/liuskywalkerjskd__mujoco_iiwa7_r800
title: KUKA LBR iiwa 7 R800 (MuJoCo MJCF)
intro: KUKA LBR iiwa 7 R800 (MuJoCo MJCF), adapted from liuskywalkerjskd/mujoco_iiwa7_r800. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
